parts.name: CheckboxRoot
parts.description: The box: a native `<input type="checkbox">`. Its children are rendered after it, as its siblings. Style it with `appearance: none`, `:checked`, `:indeterminate`, `:disabled`, `:focus-visible` and `:user-invalid`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the box is checked. Pass it with `onCheckedChange` to control the box. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over (`checked={setting}`); one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the box is checked at first, when it isn't controlled. Also its `checked` attribute: what a form reset puts back.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the user checks or clears the box, and once when a form reset changes an uncontrolled box. It is called in a change of its own, so it may be an action that saves: the box is never held by it. A controlled box shows `checked` until the owner writes the new state, or guesses it.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Shows the box as neither checked nor unchecked; `:indeterminate` matches it. A press clears it and toggles the box, as the browser does, and the box is set back to indeterminate while this stays true.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the box natively: it can't be focused or pressed, and `:disabled` matches it. A box disabled while it has focus (`disabled={pending? setting}`) takes focus back when it is enabled again, if focus hasn't moved elsewhere.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Keeps the box focusable but cancels a press or Space, so its state doesn't change. Sets `aria-readonly` and `data-readonly`. `readOnly={pending? setting}` locks it while a save is out without losing focus.

props.name: required
props.description: Sets the native `required` attribute: the box must be checked for its form, or its Field, to be valid.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the box submits `value` under while it is checked. Inside a FieldRoot, the field's `name` is used when this is absent.

props.name: value
props.description: What the box submits with its form while checked; the browser's default is `"on"`. Inside a CheckboxGroup, the value the group's list holds while this box is checked.

props.name: parent
props.description: Inside a CheckboxGroup with `allValues`: makes this the box that checks or clears all the others. It is checked when all are, indeterminate when some are, and submits nothing.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the box's state differs from its initial one.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present while the box is checked.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-parent
dataAttributes.description: Present on the parent box of a CheckboxGroup.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present once the box has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Inside a FieldRoot: present when the field has been validated and is valid.

parts.name: CheckboxIndicator
parts.description: A mark shown beside the box, always in the document. Place it in CheckboxRoot, where it is the box's next sibling, and show it with `.Checkbox:checked + .Indicator` and `.Checkbox:indeterminate + .Indicator`. It is `aria-hidden`: the box's own state is what assistive technology gets.
